page.overview:
What is Dragon Palace of the East Sea?

The palace is located at the bottom of the East Sea, below the stream under the iron bridge that connects the Water Curtain Cave with the waterfall of the Flowers and Fruit Mountain. It is described to be adorned with green-jade and contains shell portals.

Ao Guang resides in the palace with his wife, the Dragon Queen, Dragon sons and grandsons. His entourage include shrimp soldiers, crab generals, perch commanders, whiting lieutenants, eel porters, bream admirals and carp brigadiers.

The palace contains an area called where many immortal weapons and other treasures are stored. The weapons from the arsenal that were presented to Sun Wukong includes a long-handled scimitar, a nine-pronged fork (weighing 3600 pounds), and a giant halberd (7200 pounds). In the center of the treasury is a piece of rare magic iron pillar by which the depth of the were measured.

After Sun Wukong taught his monkey brethen how to use weapons, he found it cumbersome to use earthly weapons. He decided to obtains weapons from the Dragon Palace of the East Sea. After trying out every weapon in the armoury, Wukong settled on the Ruyi Jingu Bang.
